title: Eco Mark Scheme
definition: A voluntary labeling scheme introduced by the Government of India in 1991 to identify consumer products that meet specific environmental criteria while maintaining quality standards.
importanceInUpsc: Relevant for Environment (GS-III) under sustainable consumption, pollution control, and government policy initiatives. Frequently tested in the context of 'Green Economy' and 'Sustainable Development Goals'.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Eco Mark Scheme.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of Environmental Protection Act, 1986
Concepts of Sustainable Consumption and Production (SCP)
